1670.content: . Ugur Guven is an Aerospace Engineer (Ph.D.), and a Nuclear Engineer (MSc), and his area of specialization is Nuclear Rocket Propulsion and Interstellar Travel. During his 28 years of career, he has published over 25 books, over 100 journal papers, and 250+ conference papers. Dr. Guven served as the Advisory Council Member of the UN Center for Science and Technology Education in the Asia Pacific Region from 2015 to 2022, and he actively participates in NASA focus group meetings such as LEAG. Dr
1670.title: Faculty Profile - Ugur Guven Nuclear

metadata.qualifications: nuclear engineer (msc), aerospace engineer (phd) college/university: introduction: dr
metadata.specialization: is nuclear rocket propulsion and interstellar travel
metadata.experience: 28 years of career

1671.content: . Dr. Guven is the Founder and Director of the Indo-French Academic Alliance, and he is currently in the process of forming the Indo- French Aerospace Consortium. In addition, Dr. Guven is the CEO of Prometheus Space UK Ltd. and also chief advisor to Phoenix Space UK and to Syena SPAC, USA. To help pave the way for the future of the aerospace sector, Dr. Guven is in the advisory board of several aerospace companies and startups including Bellatrix Aerospace

1672.content: . In addition, Dr. Ugur Guven is an academic board member of LIPS Research Foundation in collaboration with European International University – Paris and also serves on the Advisory Board of Internshape India. Currently, he actively serves on the editorial board of 10 international journals including Space Research Journal, and Current Research in Space Science, and continues to serve on several international committees across the world

2205.content: . Computer Science and Engineering Program Description B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering programme provides you with a sound knowledge of computing principles and applications in scientific and engineering domains. It develops in you an ability to analyze complex engineering problems and generate solutions through computing. It also gives you exposure to principles and practices of design and development of computing systems
2205.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

2206.content: . The graduates will apply their knowledge of science, mathematics, and computer science and engineering to identify and solve complex engineering problems across a broad range of application areas. The graduates will work and communicate effectively in interdisciplinary environment, either independently or in a team, and demonstrate significant leadership qualities
2206.title: Faculty Profile -

2207.content: . USP of the course: The course is of four years it will help students in designing software systems/developments, or processes to meet identified needs within economic, environmental and social constraints. It will help students for new inventions, a patent or an innovation, in the areas of Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Big Data Analytics, Security and Cryptography, Database Management, Quantum Computing, Mobile Computing State-of-the-art labs with the latest software
2207.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

PROGRAMME OUTCOMES PO1: Engineering knowledge: To apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems. PO2: Problem analysis: To identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences
2208.title: Faculty Profile -

2960.content: About The Centre for Conflict Resolution (CCR) is committed to transforming how disputes are addressed, with a strong emphasis on alternative resolution mechanisms such as arbitration, mediation, and negotiation. It fosters a culture of constructive dialogue through hands-on training, simulated exercises, and community engagement
2960.title: GD Goenka University

2961.content: . The Centre will facilitate dispute resolution through its Institutional Arbitration and Mediation Centre while also hosting workshops, international competitions, and policy discussions to equip students and professionals with practical skills. Collaborations with organizations like the Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM) enhance research opportunities and contribute to easing judicial backlogs
2961.title: GD Goenka University

2962.content: . This initiative is instrumental in preparing a generation of legal professionals capable of handling complex disputes with empathy and efficiency. Objective of the Centre Equip students with knowledge and practical skills in mediation, arbitration, and negotiation as effective alternatives to litigation. Conduct research on conflict resolution mechanisms, legal frameworks, and policy recommendations for improvement of justice delivery system
2962.title: GD Goenka University

2963.content: . Offer students hands-on experience through simulated exercises, and resolution of real-life cases. Engage in community outreach programs, advocacy, and awareness campaigns to promote peaceful dispute resolution and advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Collaborate with legal practitioners, government institutions, and international organizations to enhance knowledge exchange and career opportunities in conflict resolution
2963.title: GD Goenka University

2964.content: . Research Extension Activities Allied Activities Research Highlights Research Conducting empirical research to investigate the effectiveness of mediation, arbitration, and negotiation in resolving legal disputes and enhancing access to justice. Analyzing strategies for early conflict detection, community-based dispute resolution, and sustainable peace initiatives. Examining national and international laws, judicial interventions, and policy reforms that impact dispute resolution and justice delivery
2964.title: GD Goenka University

2965.content: . Extension Activities Highlights Extension Activities Organizing capacity-building workshops for students and faculty on effective conflict resolution techniques. Conducting outreach programs to educate the public on alternative dispute resolution (ADR) methods and access to justice. Collaborating with legal institutions, policymakers, and non-governmental organizations to develop conflict resolution policies and implement peacebuilding initiatives
2965.title: GD Goenka University

2966.content: . Allied Activities Highlights Allied Activities Publishing research papers, reports, and case studies on emerging trends and best practices in conflict resolution. Conducting collaborative studies integrating law, psychology, sociology, political science, and other disciplines to develop holistic approaches to conflict resolution. Exploring digital platforms, AI, and virtual mediation tools to improve access to justice and efficiency in dispute resolution
2966.title: GD Goenka University

2967.content: . Mission To foster a society where conflicts are resolved through dialogue, fairness, and innovative legal approaches, shaping a more just and harmonious world. To lead in legal education and research on dispute resolution, advancing alternative mechanisms that enhance access to justice and sustainable peace. To cultivate a culture of effective conflict management by bridging theory and practice, preparing legal experts to address disputes with professionalism and integrity
2967.title: GD Goenka University

2968.content: . Vision To be a centre of excellence in conflict resolution, fostering a culture of peaceful dispute settlement through legal research, practical training, and community engagement. Head of Centre s Message The Indian judicial system has been actively seeking a feasible conflict resolution mechanism to reduce the mammoth pendency of cases in courts
2968.title: GD Goenka University

2969.content: . The objective of conflict resolution is to achieve a mutually agreeable settlement that meets the satisfaction of all parties concerned, without resorting to formal court proceedings, thereby creating a win-win situation for both the parties. The aim of the Centre for Conflict Resolution (CCR), established by School of Law, GD Goenka University is the advancement of research, scholarship, education and training in the fields of arbitration, mediation and negotiation
2969.title: GD Goenka University

2970.content: . The CCR represents a collaborative effort by the School of Law GD Goenka University and Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM). The Centre aspires to cultivate a generation of legal practitioners who prioritize harmony, empathy, and innovative problem-solving in their approach to conflict resolution. 3695.content: . Ugur Guven is an Aerospace Engineer (Ph.D.), and a Nuclear Engineer (MSc), and his area of specialization is Nuclear Rocket Propulsion and Interstellar Travel. During his 28 years of career, he has published over 25 books, over 100 journal papers, and 250+ conference papers. Dr. Guven served as the Advisory Council Member of the UN Center for Science and Technology Education in the Asia Pacific Region from 2015 to 2022, and he actively participates in NASA focus group meetings such as LEAG. Dr
3695.title: Faculty Profile - Ugur Guven Nuclear

3696.content: . Dr. Guven is the Founder and Director of the Indo-French Academic Alliance, and he is currently in the process of forming the Indo- French Aerospace Consortium. In addition, Dr. Guven is the CEO of Prometheus Space UK Ltd. and also chief advisor to Phoenix Space UK and to Syena SPAC, USA. To help pave the way for the future of the aerospace sector, Dr. Guven is in the advisory board of several aerospace companies and startups including Bellatrix Aerospace

3697.content: . In addition, Dr. Ugur Guven is an academic board member of LIPS Research Foundation in collaboration with European International University – Paris and also serves on the Advisory Board of Internshape India. Currently, he actively serves on the editorial board of 10 international journals including Space Research Journal, and Current Research in Space Science, and continues to serve on several international committees across the world

Dr. Ugur Guven also works in improving educational and pedagogical techniques in higher education, as he travels frequently all over the world to give various seminars and workshops. On an alternative front, Dr

4240.content: . Computer Science and Engineering Program Description B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering programme provides you with a sound knowledge of computing principles and applications in scientific and engineering domains. It develops in you an ability to analyze complex engineering problems and generate solutions through computing. It also gives you exposure to principles and practices of design and development of computing systems
4240.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

4241.content: . The graduates will apply their knowledge of science, mathematics, and computer science and engineering to identify and solve complex engineering problems across a broad range of application areas. The graduates will work and communicate effectively in interdisciplinary environment, either independently or in a team, and demonstrate significant leadership qualities
4241.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

4242.content: . USP of the course: The course is of four years it will help students in designing software systems/developments, or processes to meet identified needs within economic, environmental and social constraints. It will help students for new inventions, a patent or an innovation, in the areas of Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Big Data Analytics, Security and Cryptography, Database Management, Quantum Computing, Mobile Computing State-of-the-art labs with the latest software
4242.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

4243.content: . PROGRAMME OUTCOMES PO1: Engineering knowledge: To apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems. PO2: Problem analysis: To identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences
4243.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

4982.content: About The Centre for Conflict Resolution (CCR) is committed to transforming how disputes are addressed, with a strong emphasis on alternative resolution mechanisms such as arbitration, mediation, and negotiation. It fosters a culture of constructive dialogue through hands-on training, simulated exercises, and community engagement
4982.title: GD Goenka University

4983.content: . The Centre will facilitate dispute resolution through its Institutional Arbitration and Mediation Centre while also hosting workshops, international competitions, and policy discussions to equip students and professionals with practical skills. Collaborations with organizations like the Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM) enhance research opportunities and contribute to easing judicial backlogs
4983.title: GD Goenka University

4984.content: . This initiative is instrumental in preparing a generation of legal professionals capable of handling complex disputes with empathy and efficiency. Objective of the Centre Equip students with knowledge and practical skills in mediation, arbitration, and negotiation as effective alternatives to litigation. Conduct research on conflict resolution mechanisms, legal frameworks, and policy recommendations for improvement of justice delivery system
4984.title: GD Goenka University

4985.content: . Offer students hands-on experience through simulated exercises, and resolution of real-life cases. Engage in community outreach programs, advocacy, and awareness campaigns to promote peaceful dispute resolution and advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Collaborate with legal practitioners, government institutions, and international organizations to enhance knowledge exchange and career opportunities in conflict resolution
4985.title: GD Goenka University

4986.content: . Research Extension Activities Allied Activities Research Highlights Research Conducting empirical research to investigate the effectiveness of mediation, arbitration, and negotiation in resolving legal disputes and enhancing access to justice. Analyzing strategies for early conflict detection, community-based dispute resolution, and sustainable peace initiatives. Examining national and international laws, judicial interventions, and policy reforms that impact dispute resolution and justice delivery
4986.title: GD Goenka University

4987.content: . Extension Activities Highlights Extension Activities Organizing capacity-building workshops for students and faculty on effective conflict resolution techniques. Conducting outreach programs to educate the public on alternative dispute resolution (ADR) methods and access to justice. Collaborating with legal institutions, policymakers, and non-governmental organizations to develop conflict resolution policies and implement peacebuilding initiatives
4987.title: GD Goenka University

4988.content: . Allied Activities Highlights Allied Activities Publishing research papers, reports, and case studies on emerging trends and best practices in conflict resolution. Conducting collaborative studies integrating law, psychology, sociology, political science, and other disciplines to develop holistic approaches to conflict resolution. Exploring digital platforms, AI, and virtual mediation tools to improve access to justice and efficiency in dispute resolution
4988.title: GD Goenka University

4989.content: . Mission To foster a society where conflicts are resolved through dialogue, fairness, and innovative legal approaches, shaping a more just and harmonious world. To lead in legal education and research on dispute resolution, advancing alternative mechanisms that enhance access to justice and sustainable peace. To cultivate a culture of effective conflict management by bridging theory and practice, preparing legal experts to address disputes with professionalism and integrity
4989.title: GD Goenka University

4990.content: . Vision To be a centre of excellence in conflict resolution, fostering a culture of peaceful dispute settlement through legal research, practical training, and community engagement. Head of Centre s Message The Indian judicial system has been actively seeking a feasible conflict resolution mechanism to reduce the mammoth pendency of cases in courts
4990.title: GD Goenka University

4991.content: . The objective of conflict resolution is to achieve a mutually agreeable settlement that meets the satisfaction of all parties concerned, without resorting to formal court proceedings, thereby creating a win-win situation for both the parties. The aim of the Centre for Conflict Resolution (CCR), established by School of Law, GD Goenka University is the advancement of research, scholarship, education and training in the fields of arbitration, mediation and negotiation
4991.title: GD Goenka University

4992.content: . The CCR represents a collaborative effort by the School of Law GD Goenka University and Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM). The Centre aspires to cultivate a generation of legal practitioners who prioritize harmony, empathy, and innovative problem-solving in their approach to conflict resolution. 5735.content: . Ugur Guven is an Aerospace Engineer (Ph.D.), and a Nuclear Engineer (MSc), and his area of specialization is Nuclear Rocket Propulsion and Interstellar Travel. During his 28 years of career, he has published over 25 books, over 100 journal papers, and 250+ conference papers. Dr. Guven served as the Advisory Council Member of the UN Center for Science and Technology Education in the Asia Pacific Region from 2015 to 2022, and he actively participates in NASA focus group meetings such as LEAG. Dr
5735.title: Faculty Profile - Ugur Guven Nuclear

metadata.qualifications: nuclear engineer (msc), aerospace engineer (phd) college/university: introduction: dr
metadata.specialization: is nuclear rocket propulsion and interstellar travel
metadata.experience: 28 years of career

5736.content: . Dr. Guven is the Founder and Director of the Indo-French Academic Alliance, and he is currently in the process of forming the Indo- French Aerospace Consortium. In addition, Dr. Guven is the CEO of Prometheus Space UK Ltd. and also chief advisor to Phoenix Space UK and to Syena SPAC, USA. To help pave the way for the future of the aerospace sector, Dr. Guven is in the advisory board of several aerospace companies and startups including Bellatrix Aerospace

5737.content: . In addition, Dr. Ugur Guven is an academic board member of LIPS Research Foundation in collaboration with European International University – Paris and also serves on the Advisory Board of Internshape India. Currently, he actively serves on the editorial board of 10 international journals including Space Research Journal, and Current Research in Space Science, and continues to serve on several international committees across the world

6270.content: . Computer Science and Engineering Program Description B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering programme provides you with a sound knowledge of computing principles and applications in scientific and engineering domains. It develops in you an ability to analyze complex engineering problems and generate solutions through computing. It also gives you exposure to principles and practices of design and development of computing systems
6270.title: Faculty Profile -

6271.content: . The graduates will apply their knowledge of science, mathematics, and computer science and engineering to identify and solve complex engineering problems across a broad range of application areas. The graduates will work and communicate effectively in interdisciplinary environment, either independently or in a team, and demonstrate significant leadership qualities

USP of the course: The course is of four years it will help students in designing software systems/developments, or processes to meet identified needs within economic, environmental and social constraints. It will help students for new inventions, a patent or an innovation, in the areas of Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Big Data Analytics, Security and Cryptography, Database Management, Quantum Computing, Mobile Computing State-of-the-art labs with the latest software

PROGRAMME OUTCOMES PO1: Engineering knowledge: To apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems. PO2: Problem analysis: To identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences
6273.title: Faculty Profile -

7348.content: . Ugur Guven is an Aerospace Engineer (Ph.D.), and a Nuclear Engineer (MSc), and his area of specialization is Nuclear Rocket Propulsion and Interstellar Travel. 7517.content: About The Centre for Conflict Resolution (CCR) is committed to transforming how disputes are addressed, with a strong emphasis on alternative resolution mechanisms such as arbitration, mediation, and negotiation. It fosters a culture of constructive dialogue through hands-on training, simulated exercises, and community engagement
7517.title: GD Goenka University

7518.content: . The Centre will facilitate dispute resolution through its Institutional Arbitration and Mediation Centre while also hosting workshops, international competitions, and policy discussions to equip students and professionals with practical skills. Collaborations with organizations like the Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM) enhance research opportunities and contribute to easing judicial backlogs
7518.title: GD Goenka University

7519.content: . This initiative is instrumental in preparing a generation of legal professionals capable of handling complex disputes with empathy and efficiency. Objective of the Centre Equip students with knowledge and practical skills in mediation, arbitration, and negotiation as effective alternatives to litigation. Conduct research on conflict resolution mechanisms, legal frameworks, and policy recommendations for improvement of justice delivery system
7519.title: GD Goenka University

7520.content: . Offer students hands-on experience through simulated exercises, and resolution of real-life cases. Engage in community outreach programs, advocacy, and awareness campaigns to promote peaceful dispute resolution and advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Collaborate with legal practitioners, government institutions, and international organizations to enhance knowledge exchange and career opportunities in conflict resolution
7520.title: GD Goenka University

7521.content: . Research Extension Activities Allied Activities Research Highlights Research Conducting empirical research to investigate the effectiveness of mediation, arbitration, and negotiation in resolving legal disputes and enhancing access to justice. Analyzing strategies for early conflict detection, community-based dispute resolution, and sustainable peace initiatives. Examining national and international laws, judicial interventions, and policy reforms that impact dispute resolution and justice delivery
7521.title: GD Goenka University

7522.content: . Extension Activities Highlights Extension Activities Organizing capacity-building workshops for students and faculty on effective conflict resolution techniques. Conducting outreach programs to educate the public on alternative dispute resolution (ADR) methods and access to justice. Collaborating with legal institutions, policymakers, and non-governmental organizations to develop conflict resolution policies and implement peacebuilding initiatives
7522.title: GD Goenka University

7523.content: . Allied Activities Highlights Allied Activities Publishing research papers, reports, and case studies on emerging trends and best practices in conflict resolution. Conducting collaborative studies integrating law, psychology, sociology, political science, and other disciplines to develop holistic approaches to conflict resolution. Exploring digital platforms, AI, and virtual mediation tools to improve access to justice and efficiency in dispute resolution
7523.title: GD Goenka University

7524.content: . Mission To foster a society where conflicts are resolved through dialogue, fairness, and innovative legal approaches, shaping a more just and harmonious world. To lead in legal education and research on dispute resolution, advancing alternative mechanisms that enhance access to justice and sustainable peace. To cultivate a culture of effective conflict management by bridging theory and practice, preparing legal experts to address disputes with professionalism and integrity
7524.title: GD Goenka University

7525.content: . Vision To be a centre of excellence in conflict resolution, fostering a culture of peaceful dispute settlement through legal research, practical training, and community engagement. Head of Centre s Message The Indian judicial system has been actively seeking a feasible conflict resolution mechanism to reduce the mammoth pendency of cases in courts
7525.title: GD Goenka University

7526.content: . The objective of conflict resolution is to achieve a mutually agreeable settlement that meets the satisfaction of all parties concerned, without resorting to formal court proceedings, thereby creating a win-win situation for both the parties. The aim of the Centre for Conflict Resolution (CCR), established by School of Law, GD Goenka University is the advancement of research, scholarship, education and training in the fields of arbitration, mediation and negotiation
7526.title: GD Goenka University

7527.content: . The CCR represents a collaborative effort by the School of Law GD Goenka University and Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM). The Centre aspires to cultivate a generation of legal practitioners who prioritize harmony, empathy, and innovative problem-solving in their approach to conflict resolution. 8305.content: . Computer Science and Engineering Program Description B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering programme provides you with a sound knowledge of computing principles and applications in scientific and engineering domains. It develops in you an ability to analyze complex engineering problems and generate solutions through computing. It also gives you exposure to principles and practices of design and development of computing systems
8305.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8306.content: . The graduates will apply their knowledge of science, mathematics, and computer science and engineering to identify and solve complex engineering problems across a broad range of application areas. The graduates will work and communicate effectively in interdisciplinary environment, either independently or in a team, and demonstrate significant leadership qualities
8306.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8307.content: . USP of the course: The course is of four years it will help students in designing software systems/developments, or processes to meet identified needs within economic, environmental and social constraints. It will help students for new inventions, a patent or an innovation, in the areas of Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Big Data Analytics, Security and Cryptography, Database Management, Quantum Computing, Mobile Computing State-of-the-art labs with the latest software
8307.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8308.content: . PROGRAMME OUTCOMES PO1: Engineering knowledge: To apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems. PO2: Problem analysis: To identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences
8308.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8309.content: . PO3: Design/development of solutions: To design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations
8309.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8310.content: . PO4: Conduct investigations of complex problems: T use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions. PO5: Modern tool usage: To create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations
8310.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8311.content: . PO6: The engineer and society: To apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice. PO7: Environment and sustainability: To understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development
8311.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8312.content: . PO8: Ethics: To apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice. PO9: Individual and Team Work: To function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings
8312.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8313.content: . PO10: Communication: To communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions
8313.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

8314.content: . PO11: Project Management and Finance: To demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments. PO12: Life-long Learning: To recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change

8654.content: . Leadership Aerospace Engineering Department is under the College of Engineering and Science, and it is headed by Dr. Ugur Guven who is an international professor, who has specialized in Nuclear Rocket Propulsion and Interstellar Travel. Dr Ugur Guven is an Aerospace Engineer as well as a Nuclear Engineer and he has published over 17 books, over 100 journal papers and 250+ conference papers

8655.content: . Moreover, he was the Advisory Council Member of UN CSSTEAP, and he actively participates in international projects and meetings such as the NASA LEAG group. Dr. Guven is also the Founder Director of the Indo-French Academic Alliance, and he is currently in the process of forming the Indo-French Aerospace Consortium.In addition, Dr Guven is the CEO of Prometheus Space UK Ltd. and also chief advisor to Phoenix Space UK and to Syena SPAC, USA

9402.content: . Ugur Guven is an Aerospace Engineer (Ph.D.), and a Nuclear Engineer (MSc), and his area of specialization is Nuclear Rocket Propulsion and Interstellar Travel. During his 28 years of career, he has published over 25 books, over 100 journal papers, and 250+ conference papers. Dr. Guven served as the Advisory Council Member of the UN Center for Science and Technology Education in the Asia Pacific Region from 2015 to 2022, and he actively participates in NASA focus group meetings such as LEAG. Dr

9403.content: . Dr. Guven is the Founder and Director of the Indo-French Academic Alliance, and he is currently in the process of forming the Indo- French Aerospace Consortium. In addition, Dr. Guven is the CEO of Prometheus Space UK Ltd. and also chief advisor to Phoenix Space UK and to Syena SPAC, USA. To help pave the way for the future of the aerospace sector, Dr. Guven is in the advisory board of several aerospace companies and startups including Bellatrix Aerospace

Objective of the Centre Equip students with knowledge and practical skills in mediation, arbitration, and negotiation as effective alternatives to litigation. Conduct research on conflict resolution mechanisms, legal frameworks, and policy recommendations for improvement of justice delivery system
9573.title: GD Goenka University

9574.content: . Offer students hands-on experience through simulated exercises, and resolution of real-life cases. Engage in community outreach programs, advocacy, and awareness campaigns to promote peaceful dispute resolution and advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Collaborate with legal practitioners, government institutions, and international organizations to enhance knowledge exchange and career opportunities in conflict resolution
9574.title: GD Goenka University

9575.content: . Research Extension Activities Allied Activities Research Highlights Research Conducting empirical research to investigate the effectiveness of mediation, arbitration, and negotiation in resolving legal disputes and enhancing access to justice. Analyzing strategies for early conflict detection, community-based dispute resolution, and sustainable peace initiatives. Examining national and international laws, judicial interventions, and policy reforms that impact dispute resolution and justice delivery
9575.title: GD Goenka University

9576.content: . Extension Activities Highlights Extension Activities Organizing capacity-building workshops for students and faculty on effective conflict resolution techniques. Conducting outreach programs to educate the public on alternative dispute resolution (ADR) methods and access to justice. Collaborating with legal institutions, policymakers, and non-governmental organizations to develop conflict resolution policies and implement peacebuilding initiatives
9576.title: GD Goenka University

9577.content: . Allied Activities Highlights Allied Activities Publishing research papers, reports, and case studies on emerging trends and best practices in conflict resolution. Conducting collaborative studies integrating law, psychology, sociology, political science, and other disciplines to develop holistic approaches to conflict resolution. Exploring digital platforms, AI, and virtual mediation tools to improve access to justice and efficiency in dispute resolution
9577.title: GD Goenka University

9578.content: . Mission To foster a society where conflicts are resolved through dialogue, fairness, and innovative legal approaches, shaping a more just and harmonious world. To lead in legal education and research on dispute resolution, advancing alternative mechanisms that enhance access to justice and sustainable peace. To cultivate a culture of effective conflict management by bridging theory and practice, preparing legal experts to address disputes with professionalism and integrity
9578.title: GD Goenka University

9579.content: . Vision To be a centre of excellence in conflict resolution, fostering a culture of peaceful dispute settlement through legal research, practical training, and community engagement. Head of Centre s Message The Indian judicial system has been actively seeking a feasible conflict resolution mechanism to reduce the mammoth pendency of cases in courts
9579.title: GD Goenka University

9580.content: . The objective of conflict resolution is to achieve a mutually agreeable settlement that meets the satisfaction of all parties concerned, without resorting to formal court proceedings, thereby creating a win-win situation for both the parties. The aim of the Centre for Conflict Resolution (CCR), established by School of Law, GD Goenka University is the advancement of research, scholarship, education and training in the fields of arbitration, mediation and negotiation
9580.title: GD Goenka University

9581.content: . The CCR represents a collaborative effort by the School of Law GD Goenka University and Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM). The Centre aspires to cultivate a generation of legal practitioners who prioritize harmony, empathy, and innovative problem-solving in their approach to conflict resolution. 10379.content: . Computer Science and Engineering Program Description B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering programme provides you with a sound knowledge of computing principles and applications in scientific and engineering domains. It develops in you an ability to analyze complex engineering problems and generate solutions through computing. It also gives you exposure to principles and practices of design and development of computing systems
10379.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

10380.content: . The graduates will apply their knowledge of science, mathematics, and computer science and engineering to identify and solve complex engineering problems across a broad range of application areas. The graduates will work and communicate effectively in interdisciplinary environment, either independently or in a team, and demonstrate significant leadership qualities
10380.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

10381.content: . USP of the course: The course is of four years it will help students in designing software systems/developments, or processes to meet identified needs within economic, environmental and social constraints. It will help students for new inventions, a patent or an innovation, in the areas of Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Big Data Analytics, Security and Cryptography, Database Management, Quantum Computing, Mobile Computing State-of-the-art labs with the latest software
10381.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

10382.content: . PROGRAMME OUTCOMES PO1: Engineering knowledge: To apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems. PO2: Problem analysis: To identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences
10382.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

10383.content: . PO3: Design/development of solutions: To design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations
10383.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

10384.content: . PO4: Conduct investigations of complex problems: T use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions. PO5: Modern tool usage: To create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations
10384.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

10385.content: . PO6: The engineer and society: To apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice. PO7: Environment and sustainability: To understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development
10385.title: Faculty Profile -

metadata.specialization: to the solution of complex engineering problems

10386.content: . PO8: Ethics: To apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice. PO9: Individual and Team Work: To function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings

10684.content: . What are the Branches of Aerospace Engineering? Aerospace engineering is made up of Aeronautics, Astronautics, and Avionics. Aeronautics deals with aircraft, helicopters, airships, commercial jets, aviation technologies,UAVs and basically all commercial and military flight vehicles in atmospheric flight. This canalso have sub-branches such as Aerodynamics, Compressible Flow, CFD, Rotary Flight, UAVetc

Avionics deals with the electronics systems of both aircraft and spacecraft

An aerospace engineer will need to have fundamental knowledge of mechanical engineering,electronics engineering, propulsion engineering, and even some knowledge of civil engineering. Hence, there is a lot of scope for future career opportunities since an aerospace engineer will accumulate the background knowledge of several engineering disciplines

An Aerospace Engineer can work as an aeronautical design engineer, flight engineer, aeronauticalmaintenance engineer, Aeronautical operations specialist, satellite design engineer, avionics engineer, flight systems design, rocket engineer, space systems engineer, space mission planner
